title: Tu dekh nahi pata jabir
body:
Tu dekh nahi pata jabir
Acha hai teri beenai nahi, tu dekh nahi paata jabir..(2)
<<DIVIDER>>
Thi binte ali bazaro'n mein..(2)
be maqna o be parda jabir
<<MINI>>
tu dekh nahi paata jabir
<<DIVIDER>>
1. Jabir ye zameene karbobala
zahra ka yaha'n gulshan bikhra
jis jaa pe khade ho tum jabir
ghode se yahee'n abbas gira
pyaasi thi bateeji khaime mein..(2)
be baazu hua saqqa jabir
<<MINI>>
tu dekh nahi paata jabir
<<DIVIDER>>
2. Atthara baras ka bhai mera
seene mein lagi naize ki ani
jabir ye sunoge kis tarha
shabbir ki bhi beenayi gayi
bus ek qadam hi chalte the..(2)
girte the mere maula jabir
<<MINI>>
tu dekh nahi paata jabir
<<DIVIDER>>
3. Akbar, asghar, qasim na rahe
the aun o mohammad ke laashe
is par bhi ruki na zoro jafa
sabke laashe pamaal hue
shabbir pe chalta tha khanjar..(2)
zainab thi sare khaima jabir
<<MINI>>
tu dekh nahi paata jabir
<<DIVIDER>>
3. Phir shaam e ghareeba aa pohchi
khaimo ko jalaya aada ne
phupiyo'n ki ridao'n ko meri
naizo'n se utaara aada ne
jalta tha sakina ka kurta..(2)
asghar ka kahi'n jhula jabir
<<MINI>>
tu dekh nahi paata jabir
<<DIVIDER>>
4. Aaghaz e imamat tha mera
tohfe mein mile zanjeer o rasan
poshak yateemi ki pehne
zakhmo se bhara tha mera badan
gardan ka lahu pairo se baha..(2)
ye waqt bhi tha aaya jabir
<<MINI>>
tu dekh nahi paata jabir
<<DIVIDER>>
5. Bazaar ka haal suno jabir
pathhar the kabhi shole the kabhi
ummat thi tamashayi saari aur aale mohammad the qaidi aur habshi ghulamo ki tarha..(2)
bazaaro'n mein khencha jabir
<<MINI>>
tu dekh nahi paata jabir
<<DIVIDER>>
6. Bazaar hua jab khatm to phir
darbaar qayamat aaya tha
darbaar sharabi majme mein
zainab ko pukara jaata tha
paigham e hussaini ki khatir..(2)
jaise wo rahi zinda jabir
<<MINI>>
tu dekh nahi paata jabir
<<DIVIDER>>
7. Hasrat thi rihai ki jisko
zinda'n se reha wo ho na saki
darti thi andhere se bacchi
turbat bhi andhere mein hi bani
zinda'n mein sakina ka haaye..(2)
haatho'n pe tha jab laasha jabir
<<MINI>>
tu dekh nahi paata jabir
<<DIVIDER>>
8. Salman karega kaise bayaa'n
meesum jo mere maula ne kaha
beenai meri rukhsat na hui
ankho'n se magar khoo'n itna baha
aankho'n ke lahu se surkh hua..(2)
tha shaam ka sab rasta jabir
<<MINI>>
tu dekh nahi paata jabir
Acha hai teri beenai nahi, tu dekh nahi paata jabir..(3)
